guideline: Select one label: Stereotypical (S), Non-Stereotypical (N), or Unsure (U).

Annotators select one of the following labels: Stereotypical (S), Non‑Stereotypical (N), Unsure (U). For offensiveness, annotators rate the attribute on a Likert scale from Not offensive (‑1) to Extremely Offensive (+4).

We asked annotators to label each stereotype candidate tuple (id, attr) based on their awareness of a commonly-held opinion about the target identity group. We emphasized that they were not being asked whether they hold or agree with a stereotype, rather about the prevalence of the stereotype in society.
